description: Minutes approval workflow: submit, approve (issue), return, correct.
precondition: Minutes in the needed status; approver and secretary actors.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
Revision 1 Issued; no later revision exists.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Issued revision; actor: the current Secretary.
cases.return: New Draft revision 2 with the issued content and SupersedesId = revision 1; 201 MSG432; nobody is notified until the correction is issued.
cases.log: Saved: Draft revision (number + 1) with the issued content and the replaced-revision id; no notification; realtime minutes-changed push to the meeting's readers.

preconditions: Actor is a Member who reads the meeting.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Issued revision; actor: the Member.
cases.return: Failure Forbidden; 403 MSG397; no revision created.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
Revision 1 Issued with an unissued Draft correction (revision 2) already started.
cases.inputs: minutesId: revision 1; actor: the current Secretary.
cases.return: Failure CorrectionInProgress; 409 MSG434; no revision created.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
Revision 1 Issued with no later revision.
A simultaneous request corrects the same revision at the same time.
cases.inputs: minutesId: revision 1; actor: the current Secretary; the database's revision-number index rejects the save.
cases.return: Failure CorrectionInProgress; 409 MSG434; the other request's correction stands.
cases.log: Warning logged: concurrent correction of the revision; the existing correction stands.
